name: s-bike-hub
description: Coach from your smart-bike training hub: check-ins, plans, rides, workouts and training load for bike, run and swim.
long_description: Connects your AI assistant to S-Bike Training Hub running on your Mac (https://github.com/JHarp199345/S-Bike-Training-Hub): today's verdict and plan, morning check-ins, rides and ride stories, fitness and body-system load across bike, run, swim, walk and gym, watch file import, swim/run/ride insights, timed workouts, route planning and calibration tests. Everything stays on the Mac: the tools call the hub at http://127.0.0.1:8729, which must be running.
